# DiagnosticSeverity

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Structured, non-throwing report of a recoverable issue encountered while generating a PDF - most commonly a font that couldn't be loaded, an image that failed to decode, or a subset operation that fell back to embedding the full font. Callers retrieve the collected diagnostics from `Document.diagnostics` after `generateBytes` / `generateBytesAsync` returns and decide how to surface them (log, display, ignore, throw).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type DiagnosticSeverity = 'error' | 'warning' | 'info'
```

## Values

- `"error"`
- `"warning"`
- `"info"`
